name: Honda CL72 / CL77 Scrambler
engine: 247 or 305 cc air-cooled overhead-cam twin, two carbs, four-speed
intro: The early Honda scramblers. High pipes, a tube frame and the same twin as the Hawks.

B: It runs points ignition. Clean, gap and time the points before you chase a carb problem.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
